text.tspan: Option 1 · Amazon VPC Lattice: call services by name, so VPC IPs never matter
DNS name of the Lattice service
only cluster A's role may call orders
Best for many HTTP/gRPC services across teams and accounts, with IAM auth between them. Any associated VPC can call
any service in the network (if the auth policy allows). Costs: per service-hour, per GB and per request. Mostly layer 7.
